constraints.text: a shutdown always ends the process: the drain is capped and the exit after it is unconditional
outline 5.5.3.9: a wake never takes more than 60 s, so the drain serves new work instead of refusing it; 600 s is the inference-call limit
one ring per instance: an asker waits inside its bus process, so no second bus may serve beside a draining one
